Question: Let \(*\) be a symbol denoting the binary operation on the set \(S\) of all nonzero real numbers as follows: for any \(a,\) \(b\in S,\) \(a*b=2ab.\) Which statement is not true?

Choices.C: \(\frac{1}{2}\) is an identity element for \(*\) in \(S\)
Choices.D: Every element of \(S\) has an inverse for \(*\)
Choices.E:
\(\frac{1}{2a}\) is an inverse for \(*\) of the
element \(a\) of \(S\)
